File utilities for reading and writing integers, directory creation and removal, executable path lookup, and full-file reads.

# Purpose
This header declares file utility functions for reading and writing integer values, creating directory trees, removing directory trees, finding the current executable path, and mapping an entire file into memory. The [`fd_file_util_read_ulong`](<#fd_file_util_read_ulong>) and [`fd_file_util_read_uint`](<#fd_file_util_read_uint>) functions read a single unsigned integer from a file, while [`fd_file_util_write_ulong`](<#fd_file_util_write_ulong>) and [`fd_file_util_write_uint`](<#fd_file_util_write_uint>) write an unsigned integer to a file. The [`fd_file_util_mkdir_all`](<#fd_file_util_mkdir_all>), [`fd_file_util_rmtree`](<#fd_file_util_rmtree>), and [`fd_file_util_self_exe`](<#fd_file_util_self_exe>) functions provide common filesystem operations for directory management and executable path lookup. The [`fd_file_util_read_all`](<#fd_file_util_read_all>) function loads the full file contents into an `mmap(2)` region and returns the mapped address and file size.
